CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to the same content/time was identified.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate) is identified and the same referent has an explicit origin/organization entry; content vs status distinctions are separately present.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is directly bound to the same content's organization/access in the quoted text.

C.rationale: Explicit coordinate content (red) is identified for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: The report separately lists identified content (red coordinates) and its organization/origin (origin field) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: An explicit origin/organization field describes how the content for the referent is presented/represented.
